scope: The standing Contemporary Resort A-frame, its monorail concourse, the neighboring Bay Lake Tower and the elevated Sky Way Bridge physically linking both towers.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Owner documents the original A-frame construction, the 184 ft height, 468 ft length, 220 ft width and the route through the structure.
Written keys identify the fourth-floor main concourse and monorail, fifth-floor bridge arrival and the two rooftop hospitality levels.
Owner archives date the two towers to 1971 and 2009.
